family.description: This entry (ex DUF5336) represents 34 kDa antigenic protein homologue (MAP_0900) proteins found in bacteria. The occurrence of well-defined hydrophobic and hydrophilic portions suggests that this protein could be located in the cell wall [[cite:PUB00162455]]. Most of the family members are predicted to have have 4 trans-membrane regions.
family.name: 34 kDa antigenic protein
